item.title: L Systems
item.description: Explanation L systems carry out simple character to string replacements. You begin with a string (called the axiom) and then loop though each character in the string. Each character is then replaced by a string based on some rules. This process is repeated however many times you would like, usually called the number of iterations or the depth. Example Rules Character String A AB B A Iterations In the following example I have used the ^ character to show the current character the algorithm is looking at.
